summary: Preserved candidate PR 2993 and corrected its remaining Rust-generation-egress omission by carrying LoadSnapshot in the batch wire, caching newest-per-rank snapshots in the Rust frontend, and exposing the cache through Rust /v1/loads. Candidate and review parent PRs: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2993 and https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/3080.

tests.command: git show d0666577d91c31b154d6492cdb4eaacef2fddb1c:python/sglang/srt/rust_server/server.py | python -c '<check push_generation for payload.load_snapshot>'
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the exact candidate Rust generation encoder did not reference or serialize payload.load_snapshot (printed False).
45 tests and 19 subtests passed, including the new Rust wire snapshot regression and the candidate's Python cache/fanout compatibility coverage.
All 265 Rust unit tests passed, including newest-per-rank piggyback cache behavior and all existing positional batch-wire compatibility tests.
Built the optimized PyO3 sglang-server extension from the changed Rust source using pinned Rust 1.92 and copied it into the source package.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python python -c 'import sglang.srt.rust_extensions._server as m; print(m.__file__)'
tests.what_was_measured: Imported the rebuilt native extension from /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/rust_extensions/_server.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are scheduler-to-Rust transport/cache behavior and were validated without model weights or GPU execution; no architecture or numerical claim is made.

remaining_limitations: No live model-serving run was performed; the deterministic wire, cache, HTTP source, complete Rust unit suite, and rebuilt extension were validated instead.
Rust /v1/loads exposes JSON only; Prometheus format remains unsupported.
Rust launch configuration does not currently carry accelerator name or per-DP-rank accelerator count, so those response metadata fields are null rather than guessed.
Multi-rank and multi-node serving were not exercised.
